steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells
steps_raw.instruction: Nuclei may be isolated from 2000-100,000 cells using this protocol. Cells are already resuspended in PBS + 0.04% BSA. Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 rcf for 5min at 4 °C and re-suspend the cell pellet in 50 ul of PBS 0.04% BSA. Transfer 50 ul cell suspension to a 0.2ml tube. Proceed to next step.

steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 rcf for 00:05:00 at 4 °C .

steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells
steps_raw.instruction: Remove 45ul supernatant without touching the bottom of the tube to avoid dislodging the cell pellet.

steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells

steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate for 4 min* on ice. * Time between 3-5min, depending on cell type.

steps_raw.title: Nuclei isolation from fresh cells
